page_title: RBL 2-1 HEI | RB Leipzig v Heidenheim 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
90+2' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Christopher Lenz (RB Leipzig) replaces David Raum.

90+1' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Kevin Muller pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) comes onto the pitch so that Christoph Baumgartner can be given a rest.
88' The booking goes to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
86' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
86' Here is a change. Jan Schoppner is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
86' Jan-Niklas Beste will be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
82' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
80' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
78' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Xavi Simons and he is replaced by Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is coming onto the pitch as Yussuf Poulsen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
76' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' The corner kick from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
74' A substitution has been made. Marvin Pieringer is replaced by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
72' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' A great run by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
68' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) replacing Norman Theuerkauf.
68' Here's the change. Lennard Maloney leaves the pitch and Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
67' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
62' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
59' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
59' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
58' Christian Dingert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig).
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
53' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
49' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

47' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Christian Dingert with no other option than to blow for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Christian Dingert starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 2 - 1 Goal! Lennard Maloney gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) glances a header into the net. 2:1.
45+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) was set free in the area by David Raum and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
41' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
40' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
35' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
34' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Kevin Muller.
29' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is going to take the penalty!
28' Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul after Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY to RB Leipzig! Let's see who will take responsibility.
27' Surely that's handball by one of the RB Leipzig players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

24' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes a decision to dribble through the defence towards the goal. He gets inside the box, pulls the trigger, but hits the ball very poorly and it goes yards wide of the target.
22' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
20' David Raum (RB Leipzig) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
18' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
16' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Kevin Muller makes a great save.

14' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom right corner, but Kevin Muller makes a nice save.
13' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.

12' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) inside the box. He lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Kevin Muller was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
12' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
9' A cross from David Raum (RB Leipzig) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
8' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' David Raum (RB Leipzig) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Kevin Muller anticipates well and smothers the ball.
3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Christian Dingert.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
